{{Quote|Torosogt River. We've made good time. Once across, we will truly be in the realm of the Alwari. No towns beyond this place. No fault-finding, arrogant 'Unity.'|Kyakhta |<ref name="AS">''[[The Approaching Storm]]''</ref>}}
The '''Torosogt River''' was a deep river on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ansion/Legends|Ansion]]. It was a border between the areas of the [[Alwari]] and the [[Unity of Community]].<ref name="AS" />
